body: Restore parameters removed in v1.1.17 and v1.2.0, which removed or renamed parameters without a major version bump. This puts the old keys back alongside the new ones, and marks them deprecated in the `description` field. They will be removed in v2.0.0 (#304).
title: Restore the parameters removed or renamed in v1.1.17 and v1.2.0

body: Raise minimum Julia version to 1.10. This fixes the [error](https://github.com/JuliaRegistries/General/pull/170260#issuecomment-5943377555) when releasing v1.2.1: I was not able to load the package on julia 1.1.1 (lowest compatible version)(i.e. import ClimaParams failed). See the AutoMerge logs for details.
title: Raise minimum Julia version to 1.10
